verdict.rationale: Limitless documents a Developer API with API-key authentication, endpoints to list, search, fetch, delete and download lifelogs, audio and chats, a published rate limit, and an example repository. This lets scripts and agents automate data retrieval without the app UI. Core capture, however, depends on the physical Pendant, and nothing describes running the product itself headlessly or in CI. Missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runtime, CI/automation documentation or examples, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of scripted use.
